token.description: The token from the link of the mail (the part after #token=)

400.description: The link is invalid or has expired

429.description: Too many requests from this address

description:
Tells whether a reset token can still be used, so the page of the link can show its form or its refusal. An unknown, used, expired or replaced token, a disabled user, and any token while a reset by mail is not offered all answer 400 `error.reset-invalid`. Shares the limit of POST /password-reset.

Needs: nothing (public)
